name_for_human: Looper Squad #156 - A2A Security Audit Gateway
description_for_model: Automated, real-time security analysis and risk evaluation for smart contracts deployed on Base (Chain ID 8453). Each call costs 0.10 USDC on Base, paid to the recipient wallet in x_a2a_payment. Workflow: 1) send exactly 0.10 USDC (asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) on Base to 0x611270E226a1999A97B4b7856D358d2210C5EC93; 2) call auditContract with 'sender' = the paying wallet address, 'signal' = the target contract address to audit, 'txHash' = the payment transaction hash. Each txHash can be used only once. On success the response is {"status": "success", "audit": "<audit report with risk assessment>"}. HTTP 402 with {"error": "..."} means the payment is missing, invalid, or already used.
description_for_human: Pay-per-call smart contract security and risk audits for AI agents on Base. 0.10 USDC per audit.
